findings.body: The previous finding remains open. If the initial answer succeeds, asks a question and leaves uncommitted changes, a failing commit nudge prevents `_question` from running. Claude's normal and design paths leave `outcome` as `failed` when the nudge raises (worker.py:188–196); Codex explicitly changes it to `failed` (212–213). The initial question gets neither a pending record nor an occurrence id, so subsequent work can proceed unanswered; close.py:63–65 blocks only persisted questions. The nudge tests cover successful nudges only. Preserve questions from successful answers independently of the nudge's outcome.
findings.title: Preserve pending questions when a commit nudge fails
